summary.intent: Land a series of fixes in the callisto repo, each as its own branch and PR via Entire trails: first the generated matrix workflow checking out the release commit (E170), then making release attestation verification pin a source ref.
summary.outcome: PR #446 was opened and titled for the matrix workflow checkout fix. The attestation fix was implemented on fix/attestation-source-ref (installer, CI workflow, stub-based tests, changeset), validated against 12 recent releases, committed and pushed, but its PR was not yet confirmed or opened.

repo: Entire creates the PR itself after a branch is pushed and linked to a trail (`entire trail link 233`); the PR appears after a delay, so title and body must be set with `gh pr edit` once it shows up in `gh pr list --head <branch>`.
Release attestations for callisto verify with `gh attestation verify --source-ref refs/heads/main`; all 12 recent releases passed, so pinning main will not break installs of older pinned versions.
`--signer-ref` is a different flag from `--source-ref`; using it in the installer is wrong and was caught by the installer tests.
The setup-callisto installer tests use a `gh` stub; the stub was changed from accepting any flag to an allowlist built from the real `gh attestation verify --help` flag list.
Workflow validation in this repo uses actionlint, zizmor (--offline --strict-collection), .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-policy.sh, and .github/tests/verify-action-pins.sh.
The repo uses changesets (.changeset/*.md) for user-visible fixes.

Attestation verification appears in three places: install-callisto.sh (around lines 108-132), callisto-ci.yml (around lines 292-312), and crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_artifacts.rs (around lines 205-260).

code.finding: Attestation verify call that previously pinned no source ref; now passes --source-ref refs/heads/main.
CI attestation verify call that also needed --source-ref refs/heads/main.
Third attestation call site inspected; the transcript shows no edit to it, so it may still lack a source ref pin.

workflow: Mutation-test a new test stub: temporarily swap in the wrong flag and confirm the tests fail (10 failures with --signer-ref, 0 with --source-ref) before trusting the stub.
Before tightening a security check, verify it against several historical releases to confirm it won't break existing consumers.
Scratch scripts and PR bodies live in a job tmp dir outside the repo, keeping the worktree clean.

friction: Entire's PR creation lagged behind the push, which required several sleep and poll cycles with `gh pr list` before PR #446 appeared.
The first `gh attestation verify --help` flag-extraction pipeline did not give the full list and had to be rerun with a simpler grep.
The original test stub accepted any flag, so a wrong flag like --signer-ref would have shipped unnoticed.
open_items: Open the PR for fix/attestation-source-ref and set its title and body from pr-attest.md once Entire creates it.
Check whether release_artifacts.rs (callisto-graph) should also pin --source-ref; the transcript only inspected it.
Confirm the trail link for the attestation branch succeeded; the final command's output was not shown.
